scope: Exact dependency identities embedded in the unchanged Mermaid browser runtime. Mermaid itself retains its separate upstream MIT license.
legalReview: Supplier rights and alternative license expressions are retained, not relicensed. Human review of applicable license and source-availability obligations is pending; this inventory is not legal clearance.

hashDomains.runtime: SHA-256 of raw bundle and source-map bytes; no text normalization.
hashDomains.notice: SHA-256 of UTF-8 managed notice, package-section content and legal-text content after CRLF-to-LF replacement only. No trimming or other normalization.
hashDomains.source: Raw source/member SHA-256 remains separate from the normalized retained text. Raw text SHA-256 hashes the supplied UTF-8 excerpt before newline normalization.
hashDomains.inventory: No inventory self-hash and no notice-to-inventory hash cycle. Published inventory must match the source inventory structurally.
